<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Tech''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍技師</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘指揮所に配備されている場合、「アタック・ラン」の合計値に＋1（<u>累積可能</u>）。2：自分の支配フェイズに、この技師をユーズドデッキに送る。リザーブデッキから、「デス・スター：トレンチ」を探して手札に入れる。その後でリザーブデッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Rebel-Tech-PSA-164793246.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デル・ゴーレンは通信とスキャナー妨害の専門家で、同盟軍の高等司令部に所属する以前は、反乱軍の民間型武装コルベット船、スパイラルの乗組員であった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Tech.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: If deployed at a war room, add 1 to the Attack Run total (cumulative).

2: During your control phase, send this technician to the Used Pile. Search the Reserve Deck for Death Star: Trench and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
Del Goren is an expert in communications and scanner jamming. Before he belonged to Alliance High Command, he was a crewman on the Rebel privateer corvette Spiral.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese numbers two choose-one options.

Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Tech]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
